method.scope: Only the 260 authoritative Jacksonville item detail URLs and two scripts linked by the official ordering menu.
method.restriction: Public source research only; no form submission, cart or order POST, browser automation, phone call, application execution, or runtime QA of the Fina Calle site.
method.titleComparison: HTML-decoded title and source item name compared case-insensitively after collapsing whitespace. Item IDs 2884 and 2930 had extra spaces in official page titles; both match after normalization.

menuPage.genericPhotoPlaceholder: img.fireItemImage has empty src; its paired fireItemId is empty.
menuPage.modalScriptFinding: The fireItemModal handler copies the clicked element data-image attribute into fireItemImage.src and data-iid into fireItemId. No item form supplies an associated image.
menuPage.secondScriptFinding: No fireItemImage, fireItemModal, or data-image hook.

globalReferenceNote: Repeated shared restaurant background/logo, platform graphics, and CSS font resources. These do not establish any item-to-photo association and were not assigned to dishes.
conclusion: No exact menu-item photos were found in the complete audited official ordering menu and all 260 item detail pages. This does not rule out separately captioned official restaurant photos elsewhere.
